data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Laryssa was a nymph whose name meant 'laurel wreath'. Her name was given to the city of Larissa in Thessaly, which became a center of learning and culture. In Christianity, Laryssa represents the virtues of faith, wisdom, and strength. The name Laryssa carries the meaning “Laurel wreath” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Laryssa usually hope their child will grow to embody laurel wreath and live with faith, good character and purpose.
